filter-column-age-hint: Sconder les ciartes ruades te chësta lista plu de chësc numer de dis dan sëura. Les autres listes y les ciartes cun dates de ruveda nia cunescudes resta visibles. Mudé na ciarta ne mëter nia a zero si età tla lista.
filter-on-desc: Te filtres la ciartes sun chësta tofl. Cliché ciò per mudé l filter.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Filtré la dates dla ciartes cun @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt o @listEnteredAt. Ejëmpl: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' o @endAt = none. Met danter virgulëtes l inom de n ciamp persunalisà che scumëncia cun @.
advanced-filter-description: L filter avanzà lascia scrì na stringa cun chisc operadëures: == != <= >= && || ( ) N spazi ie l separadëur danter i operadëures. Te pos filtré duc i ciamps persunalisei scrijan si inoms y valëures. Per ejëmpl: Field1 == Value1. Nota: sce i ciamps o i valëures à spazi, muesses i mëter danter virgulëtes sempies. Per ejëmpl: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Per lascé ora caraters de cuntrol singui (' \/), pos adurvé \. Per ejëmpl: Field1 == I\'m. Te pos nce cumbiné de plu cundizions. Per ejëmpl: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Normalmënter vën duc i operadëures interpretei da man ciancia a man drëta. Te pos mudé l orden cun parenteses. Per ejëmpl: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Te pos nce crì ciamps de test cun regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Va bën canche na ciarta vën criada, o si titul o descrizion vën mudà, y l test nuef à ite chësc (zënza fé desferënza danter lëtres granes y pitles).
header-logo-title: Jì zeruch ala plata de tie tofles.
imported-member-no-account: Mëmber importà — mo deguna cont che va bën
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Nculé ite n JSON de esport de Kanboard: n ogët cun "columns" (o lëures cun column_name) y na rì "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). La colones devënta listes y i lëures devënta ciartes.
import-board-instruction-deck: Nculé ite l JSON de na tofl NextCloud Deck (na tofl cun "stacks", uni stack cun si "cards"). I stacks devënta listes y la cards devënta ciartes.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Nculé ite n JSON de na cuedlada de work-packages de OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). I stac devënta listes y i work packages devënta ciartes.
import-board-instruction-issues: Nculé ite na rì JSON de issues de __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). La issues devënta ciartes abinedes tla listes Daurides / Stlutes.
import-board-instruction-asana: Nculé ite n JSON de esport di lëures de Asana ({ "data": [...] } dal esport de Asana o GET /tasks). I lëures vën abinei te sezions (memberships); i lëures fenii va te Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Nculé ite n JSON de esport de na lista ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). I stages devënta listes y i items devënta ciartes.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Nculé ite na lista de lëures markdown (la cunvenzion che adurvea i strumënc markdown-kanban coche Obsidian Kanban): tituli "## Inom dla lista", cun elemënc "- [ ]"/"- [x]" dessot. I tituli devënta listes y i elemënc devënta ciartes; nce na lista sempla cun ponc zënza ciaselins vën importeda, coche ciartes daurides.
import-board-instruction-leo: Nculé ite na strutura Leo (file .leo). I nuc dl livel plu aut devënta listes, si nuc sotan devënta ciartes cun l test dl nuet sciöche descrizion, y i nuc di livei plu bas devënta listes de control. I nuc marchei vën importei sciöche fac.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Nculé ite n file todo.txt: n lëur per riga, coche l scrij la app todo.txt y la apps cumpatibles. I lëures fenii ("x") va te Done, +project y @context devënta etichetes, (A) devënta na eticheta de priorità, y due: y t: devënta data de scadënza y de scumenciamënt.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Nculé ite l resultat de task export: na rì JSON, o n lëur per riga. I lëures fenii va te Done, project y priority devënta etichetes, annotations devënta comënc, y depends devënta dependënzes de bloch.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Descumprimé l file .boardarchive y ncolé l contignù de board.jsonl dl tofl, cun o zënza la linia de verscion. La proprietà de ragruppamënt dla veduda dl tofl deventa listes, les autres proprietés de selezion deventa etichetes, i blocs de test y de cases da segnè deventa la descrizion y na lista de control, y i comenc vën mantegnus. Les images y i alegac ne vën nia importés.
import-board-instruction-todoist: Te Todoist, giaurì l proiet, cërn l menu ⋯ dessura a man drëta, pona Manage data > Export as CSV, y nculé ite l file CSV. La sezions devënta listes, i lëures devënta ciartes, i sotlëures devënta na lista de control, la notes devënta comënc, y @labels y la priorités p1 enchin p3 devënta etichetes.
import-board-instruction-planner: Te Microsoft Planner, giaurì l plan, cërn l menu ⋯ dlongia si inom, pona Export as Excel (tl Planner classich: Export plan to Excel), y cërn chël file .xlsx. I buckets devënta listes y i lëures devënta ciartes, cun si respunsabli, dates, etichetes, lista de control y descrizion; Progress, Priority y Completed By devënta ciamps persunalisei.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: In MeisterTask, click the project name, choose Export project and export the CSV, then paste it. Sections become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, due date, assignee and tags; completed tasks keep their completion date. A CSV written for MeisterTask's own import works too.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: In Obsidian, open the Kanban board's file as Markdown (or open the .md file in a text editor), then paste all of it. Lanes become lists with their card limits, cards keep their tags, dates, priority, fields and checklist, and the Archive becomes archived cards.
import-board-instruction-linear: In Linear, export the issues as CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, or a view's export), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, teams become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their assignee, labels, dates, parent issue, priority, estimate, project and cycle.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: In TickTick, open Settings, Account, Backup & Import and generate a backup, then paste the CSV file. Each TickTick list becomes a swimlane and its columns become lists; tasks keep their tags, dates, checklist, priority and subtasks.
import-board-instruction-clickup: In ClickUp, export the tasks as CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, or a List or Table view's export with all columns), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, ClickUp lists become swimlanes, and tasks become cards with their subtasks, assignees, tags, dates, priority and time.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: In Nullboard, open the board, choose Export this board... from the menu, open the .nbx file in a text editor and paste its contents. Lists become lists and notes become cards: a note's first line is the card title and the rest its description. A raw note gets the label raw. A file with several boards imports its first board.
import-board-instruction-kanri: In Kanri, open Import & Export and choose Export individual board (or Export all data), then paste the .json file. Columns become lists and cards become cards, with their description, due date, tags and colors; a card's tasks become a checklist. From an all-data export the first board is imported.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: In Pivotal Tracker, open the project's MORE tab and choose Export CSV (or select stories and choose Bulk Actions, CSV), then paste the CSV. Each story state becomes a list and stories become cards, with their type and labels, owners, requester, dates, comments, tasks and blockers; Estimate becomes Story points and iterations become sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: In Tasks.org, open Settings, Backups and choose Export tasks, then paste the contents of that .json file. Lists become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, tags, dates, comments and subtasks; completed tasks keep their completion date, and priority becomes a custom field.
import-board-instruction-monday: In monday.com, open the board menu, choose More actions and Export board to Excel (with updates and subitems if you like), then choose that .xlsx file. The Status column becomes lists and groups become swimlanes; people, dates, timeline and tags keep their places, other columns become custom fields and updates become comments.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: In Super Productivity, open Settings, then Sync & Backup, choose Export Data and paste the contents of the sp-backup .json file. Each project becomes a swimlane and tasks become cards in To Do, In Progress, Backlog or Done, with their notes, tags, due date, time spent and sub-tasks; archived tasks become archived cards.
import-board-instruction-taiga: In Taiga, open Admin > Project > Export and download the project dump (unpack a .json.gz file first), then paste its JSON. User story statuses become lists, user stories become cards with their tasks as subtasks, epics and issues get swimlanes of their own, and sprints, tags, comments and custom attributes come along. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: In Vikunja, open Settings, choose Data Export and download the .zip file it sends you, then choose that file, or paste the data.json inside it. Kanban buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their labels, assignees, dates, description, task lists as checklists and comments; priority, percent done and done become custom fields. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-quire: In Quire, open the project menu and choose Export CSV, then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists and tasks become cards, with their subtasks as child cards, assignees, tags as labels, start, due and completed dates, description and priority as a custom field. Comments and attachments are not in Quire's CSV.
import-board-instruction-wrike: In Wrike, export a project or folder to Excel, or fill in Wrike's Excel import template, then choose that .xlsx file. Folder and project rows become swimlanes, Status becomes lists and tasks become cards, with their Key, parent task, assignees, start and end dates, dependencies and description; Priority, Duration and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: In Teamwork.com, fill in the Excel task import template (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) and save it as .xlsx, then choose that file. Task lists become lists and tasks become cards; a task starting with -, # or > becomes a subtask of the task above it (--, ## or >> one level deeper). Assignees, dates and tags keep their places; Priority, Estimated time and Complete become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: In Businessmap (formerly Kanbanize), open Advanced Search, choose Configure results to pick the columns, download the Excel file, then choose that .xlsx file. Columns are read by their English names (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): if your account uses another language, rename the header row to English first. Column becomes lists and Lane swimlanes; owners, tags, color, dates, comments and parent links keep their places, and Priority, Size, Type and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-redmine: In Redmine, open the project's Issues, choose Also available in: CSV at the bottom of the list, pick the columns (All columns, with Description) and export, then paste the CSV. Redmine names the columns in your language, so set your language to English in My account before exporting. Each status becomes a list and issues become cards, with the tracker as a label, assignee, author, dates, parent task and related issues; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done and custom fields become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-notion: In Notion, open the database as a full page, choose ••• and Export, pick Markdown & CSV, and choose the .zip file it downloads, or one database CSV from it, or paste that CSV. A column named Status becomes the lists (without one, the first column that looks like a select does, and the import report says which); rows become cards with their title, tags as labels, people as members, dates, and the page text as the description; other columns become custom fields. Relations, images and attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-plane: In Plane, open Workspace Settings, choose Exports, export the projects as JSON, CSV or Excel and download the .zip file, then choose that file, or one file from inside it, or paste the JSON or CSV. States become lists, projects become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their identifier, parent, assignees, labels, dates, links and comments; priority, estimate, cycle and module become custom fields. Plane's export has no descriptions or attachments, so they are not imported.
import-board-instruction-trello: Te tua tofl de Trello, va te 'Menu', pona 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', y copiea l test che vën ora.
import-board-instruction-csv: Encolé i valores separà da virgoles (CSV) / i valores separà da tabulazions (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Nculé ite l JSON de na crida de issues de Jira Cloud: GET /rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project=KEY&fields=*all&expand=names,schema (zënza fields dà ora mé i ID dla issues). N proiet grant vën te plates, uni una cun n nextPageToken per la plata do: met la issues de dutes la plates te na rì "issues", o importea uni plata coche si tofl cun Importé de plu tofles. Nce n ogët { "issues": [...] } de medema sort va bën. I stac de Jira devënta listes y la issues devënta ciartes. Sce te ues, tò ite na rì "automationRules" per importé regules.
import-board-instruction-excel: Cërn n file .xlsx: na tabela cun una ciarta per riga (colones coche Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates y ciamps persunalisei), o n file esportà da WeKan, nce un cun uni tofl sun si sfuei. L pas do mustra telaca colona ie tel ciamp. Uni sfuei cun na riga de testa devënta na tofl.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Te tua tofl, va te 'Menu', pona 'Esporté la tofl', y copiea l test tl file ciarià ju.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Sce te ies fai tl importé na tofl, iedeparai jëina l import tlo, y la tofl ie tla plata Dutes la tofles.

A .zip that is itself one export (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, or WeKan with attachments) is one board. When files are chosen here, Import imports them instead of the field above.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Each swimlane the import would make (a project, folder or list of the tool) becomes its own board. Parent cards and dependencies between those boards are listed in the import report.
export-all-boards-hint: Every board you can export, in one download: Excel as one workbook with a sheet per board named after it, every other format as a .zip with a file per board.

Export writes this board's lists as one, named after the board, in the JSON Wrike's API returns for workflows: create that workflow in Wrike before importing the board's Wrike Excel export, so its statuses are applied. Import reads that JSON pasted above, from WeKan or from Wrike's GET /workflows, into the chosen board: a status without a list becomes a list, and a rule marks a card complete when it is moved into a Completed or Cancelled status and incomplete in an Active or Deferred one. globalSearch-instructions-description: La crides possa avëi operadëures per la fé plu fina.  I operadëures vën scric cun l inom dl operadëur y l valëur separei da doi ponc.  Per ejëmpl, l operadëur `list:Blocked` limitea la crida ala ciartes te na lista cun l inom *Blocked*.  Sce l valëur à spazi o caraters spezieles, muessel vester danter virgulëtes (p.ej. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - ciartes te tofles che va bën cun *<title>*

globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - ciartes appartenenti a una tofl assegnata all'organisazion *<name>*

globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - ciartes in scadenza entro *<n>* dis da adesso.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ elenca dutes le ciartes oltre la loro data di scadenza.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - ciartes create *<n>* dis fa o prima
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - ciartes mudedes *<n>* dis dant o manco
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - dutes la ciartes, tl archif y nia
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - ciartes cun na data de fin
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - dove *<field>* ie uno di `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` o `__predicate_member__`.  Inserendo `-` dinant a *<field>* chir por l'assenza di un valores tl campo (per esempio `has:-due` chir por ciartes zënza una data di scadenza).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - dove *<sort-name>* ie uno di `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` o `__predicate_modified__`.  Per un ordine discendente, ajonté un `-` dinant al inom.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - dove *<n>* ie un numero intero positivo che esprime il numero dles ciartes da mostrare por pagina.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: L ie meso specifiché deplù operadours.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
I operadëures dl medem tip vën cumbinei cun *OR*.  Vën mustredes la ciartes che va bën cun una dla cundizions.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` dà la ciartes te uni lista cun l inom *Blocked* o *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: I operadëures desferënc vën cumbinei cun *AND*.  Vën mustredes mé la ciartes che va bën cun duc i operadëures desferënc.  `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` dà mé la ciartes tla lista *Available* cun na eticheta *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: I dis possa vester dac coche numer ntier positif o negatif o cun `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` o `__predicate_year__` per l tëmp atual.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: La crides de test ne fej nia desferënza danter lëtres granes y pitles.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Da standard ne vën la ciartes tl archif nia ciariedes.

feature-views-map-desc: Les ciartes desche sëgns sön na figura ciariada.
feature-approval-required: Lascia les funzions injuntades dai ajornamënc de WeKan desativades fina che n aministradú les ativëia
feature-preview-admins: I aministradus vëiga les funzions desativades por les proé imprüma
feature-pilot-users: Utilisadus de proa che vëiga ince les funzions desativades
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Inoms di utilisadus, separá da virgoles
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Salvé. Chisc inoms di utilisadus ne n'é nia gnüs ciafá:
card-field-visibility-desc: The fields of Board Settings / Card that boards can show. An unticked field is hidden from every card, minicard and Board Settings / Card of every board. No card data or board setting changes, and ticking it again shows each board as it was set. The order of the fields is each board's own.
cards-loading-lazy: Lënt (mé la ciartes che se veiga)
cards-loading-description: WeKan ciaria la ciartes dla tofl da së nstës: na tofl granda (sëura l limit de grandëza) ciaria mé la ciartes che se veiga sën (scurimënt zënza fin) y n cuntëur dal vif, ascì che la resta svelta y adurvea manco memoria y banda, ntant che la tofles plu pitles ciaria uni ciarta per l’esperienza plu sempla y cun dutes la funzions. Ne n’iel nia da mpusté. I operadëures possa for mo mëter n modus cun la variables de ambient CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) y CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: L ciarié lënt dla ciartes ie sperimental: i cuntëures dla ciartes y i limic WIP ie jusc, ma la vijions Calënder/Tabela/Gantt y la cernuda multipla mustra mé la ciartes ciariedes nchin a sën. Ciarié inò la tofles daurides do avëi mudà chësc.
render-links-as-plain-text: Mustre i links coche test sempl
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Canche ie ativà, vën duc i links (tant i links markdown coche [label](url) che i tag HTML crudi <a href>) for mustrei coche test sempl, che ne se possa nia cliché, te uni ciamp de test rich (tituli de tofles y ciartes, descrizions, comënc, listes de control, etc.). Chësc astilea links che mena via. Da standard ie desativà, ascì che i links resta da cliché.
always-show-code-as-text: Mustré for dut l code coche test sempl
always-show-code-as-text-description: Canche ie ativà, ne vën l test rich mai mustrà coche markdown o HTML: dut l codesc de urigin vën for mustrà coche test sempl te uni ciamp de test rich (tituli de tofles y ciartes, descrizions, comënc, listes de control, etc.). Chësc mustra l cuntenut plata — comënc HTML (<!-- -->), la destinazion di links markdown, JavaScript y uni auter code — ascì che dut l code se veiga for, ne se possa nia cliché y ne va nia. Da standard ie desativà, ascì che l markdown vën mustrà normel.
disable-all-import-description: Canche ie ativà, ie dutes la funzions de import desativedes: importé na tofl da WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea y Forgejo, y nce copië na tofl. La opzions dl menu de import vën platedes y l server refuda uni dumanda de import. Da standard ie desativà.
disable-all-export-description: Canche ie ativà, ie dutes la funzions de esport desativedes: esporté na tofl coche WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, o a NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, y l esport de una na injunta. La opzions dl menu de esport vën platedes y l server refuda uni dumanda de esport. Da standard ie desativà.
disable-import-avatars-description: Canche ie ativà, ne vën i avatars (imajes de profil di utënc) mai importei. Chësc vel per l import WeKan JSON, l import Trello y la sincronisazion di avatars da furnidëures de identità da ora canche n va ite (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). I inoms y i autri dac vën for mo importei; mé i avatars vën lasciei ora. Da standard ie desativà.
disable-export-avatars-description: Canche ie ativà, ne vën i avatars (imajes de profil di utënc) mai tëuc ite canche n esportea na tofl (esport WeKan JSON y CSV). I inoms utënt y i autri dac vën for mo esportei; mé i avatars vën lasciei ora. Da standard ie desativà.
anonymize-import-users: Fé anonims i utënc tl import
anonymize-import-users-description: Canche ie ativà, muda l import de na tofl WeKan JSON l inom utënt, l inom dut y la inizieles de uni utënt importà cun segnes cuntei (user1, user2, ...), tol demez si avatar, y scrij inò la menzions @username (y i ciamps dumandà-da / dat-da) tl cuntenut dla ciartes y di comënc importei. Ne vën salvà deguna identità vëira de utënt dala tofl de urigin. La parola "user" va do la rujeneda dla persona che importea. Da standard ie desativà.
anonymize-export-users: Fé anonims i utënc tl esport
anonymize-export-users-description: Canche ie ativà, muda l esport de na tofl l inom utënt, l inom dut y la inizieles de uni utënt esportà cun segnes cuntei (user1, user2, ...), tol demez si avatar, y scrij inò la menzions @username (y i ciamps dumandà-da / dat-da) tl cuntenut dla ciartes y di comënc. L file esportà ne à deguna identità vëira de utënt. La parola "user" va do la rujeneda dla persona che esportea. Da standard ie desativà.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Ies sëgur de vulëi fé anonim chësc cont? Chësc muda per dagnora l inom utënt, l inom dut y l’adressa e-mail cun valëures anonims, tol demez l avatar y desativea l azes. Nia coche tl scancelé, tën la tofles, ciartes y comënc si storia y mustra mo chësc cont, ma mé anonim. Chësta azion ne se possa nia desdì.
disable-activities-description: Canche ie ativà, ne vën la scrites dl flus de ativiteies mai registredes y mai mustredes (bara da lat dla tofl y sfuei de ativité dla ciarta). Ne vën tenì deguna storia de chi che à fat cie. Da standard ie desativà.
disable-notifications-description: Canche ie ativà, ne manda WeKan mai notificazions de tenì da ment (tla app, per e-mail o autri servizi) per deguna ativité. La ativiteies possa for mo vester registredes (sce les ne n’ie nia nce desativedes dessura); mé la notificazions vën fermedes. Da standard ie desativà.
disable-watch-description: Canche ie ativà, ie la funzion de tenì da ment desativeda — i utënc ne possa nia se scrì ite a tofles, listes o ciartes per giaurì notificazions, y uni tentatif de mudé l livel de tenì da ment vën refudà. Da standard ie desativà.
backup-description: Fé na copia de segurëza di injuntes, di avatars y/o di dac (duc i gropes de test che ne ie nia injuntes o avatars). L .zip vën mandà diretamënter al post de conservazion sielto, zënza n file provisore, coche backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, cun YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars y /data al dedite. I posć de conservazion tl cloud (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) adroa i dac d'acès mpustei tla plates de conservazion respetives.
backup-scope-description: Dut la istanza, o una organisazion. La copia de segurëza de na organisazion à si tofles y dut chël che ie sun chëles, nce la injuntes de chëla tofles — ma deguns conc de utënt y deguna mpustazions dla istanza, ajache chëles ie spartides da dutes la organisazions. Ristabilì la copia de segurëza de na organisazion scrij mé te tofles de chëla organisazion.
theme-override-all-tenants: Mudazion che vel per duc i tenants
backup-now: Fé sën na copia de segurëza
continuous-backup-description: Manda uni mudamënt dla banca dac, di injuntes, di avatars y di registri te na cartela te puec sëcundes, per pudëi ristabilì la situazion de uni momënt. La laora adum cun la copia de segurëza programeda, che fej archives cumplec.
continuous-backup-enabled: Lascia lauré la copia de segurëza zënza pausa sun chësc server
continuous-backup-target: Cartela de destinazion (troi cumpleto, sun n auter disc, na cartela spartida tla rëi o n mount rclone)
continuous-backup-include: Fé na copia de segurëza de
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Plates SQLite (plates mudedes te uni interval)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Degun motor dla banca dac possa lauré sun chësc server
continuous-backup-key-file: File dla tlé de cifratura (troi cumpleto ora dla cartela de destinazion; 64 carateri esadecimeles o na frase secreta cun almanco 16 carateri). Tenì na copia: zënza chësc file ne possa-n nia ristabilì la copia de segurëza.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Nia te n luech (mé tla cartela de destinazion)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: File dla banca dac SQLite (creà dlongia la copia de segurëza, mai scrit sura l file che ie tl'adoranza)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Adoré la banca dac SQLite fata da nuef al prossim inviament (la banca dac vedla che vën barateda vën tenida)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Ristabilì la generazion sielta al momënt sielto? La copia de segurëza zënza pausa se ferma per n curt tëmp endèna che l ristabilimënt laora.
continuous-backup-saved: Mpustazions dla copia de segurëza zënza pausa salvedes
backup-restore-add-missing: Ajonté mé i dac che mancia
backup-restore-select-first: Cërn dant na copia de segurëza dala lista.
backup-restore-confirm: Ristabilì la copia de segurëza cernuda? La injuntes y i avatars vën scric tl sistem de file y i dac tla banca dac do l modus cernù.
gcs-key-filename: Streda dl file dla tlé dl cont de servisc
gcs-key-filename-description: Sce te ues: streda a n file de tlé JSON dl cont de servisc sun l server.
gcs-credentials-description: Sce te ues: nculé ite la tlé JSON dl cont de servisc. Lascia uet per adurvé l file dla tlé o la credenziei standard.
gcs-permissions-note: Dà al cont de servisc de WeKan azes de lietura/scritura al bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → tie bucket → Permissions → Grant access. Te "New principals", nculé ite l e-mail dl cont de servisc — l valëur "client_email" de tua tlé JSON — pona cërn l rol "Storage Object Admin" y Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Lascia uet per tenì l valëur atual.
azure-account-name-description: L inom de tie cont de Azure Storage.
azure-container-description: L container blob per memorisé i files.
gcs-project-id-description: L ID de tie proiet de Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: L inom dl bucket de Cloud Storage ulache salvé i file.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: lascia uet (adurvea l endpoint dla region). Cumpatibl cun S3: l URL dl Endpoint dala console de tie MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → l to bucket → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → il inom dl tuo bucket (o Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → tie utënt → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → cërn l cajo 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Vën mustrà coche 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Medem monitor coche l Access key ID; la 'Secret access key' vën mustreda mé n iede, canche la tlé vën criada — copiea-la nlëuta (o Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → tie cont → l inom mustrà dessura (nce sot Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → tie cont → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → tie cont → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → tie cont → Data storage → Containers → tie cuntenidëur (o + Container per crië un).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → cernidëur de proiet dessura → l ID de tie proiet (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → l inom de tie bucket (o Create per crië un).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Streda sun l server WeKan al file de tlé JSON dl cont de servisc ciarià ju (crià dessot). Adurvea chësc O nculé ite l JSON tl ciamp dessot.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → tie cont de servisc → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (ciaria ju l file). Nculé ite ciò si cuntenut, o salvea l file y stabilësc si streda dessura.
cloud-settings-save-failed: Ne n’ie nia stat meso salvé la mpustazions dla memorisazion
attachment-move-storage-azure: Sposté la injunta te Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Sposté la injunta te Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Adurvé MongoDB GridFS per la memorisazion di file
migration-pausing: Se met tla pausa la migrazions...
migration-pause-failed: Ne n’ie nia stat meso mëter tla pausa la migrazions
migration-paused: La migrazions ie metudes tla pausa cun suzes
migration-start-failed: Ne n’ie nia stat meso scumencé la migrazions
migration-started: La migrazions ie scumenciedes cun suzes
migration-not-needed: Ne n’ie nia de bujën de migrazion
migration-stop-confirm: Ies sëgur de vulëi fermé dutes la migrazions?
migration-stop-failed: Ne n’ie nia stat meso fermé la migrazions
migration-stopped: La migrazions ie fermedes cun suzes
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Per udëi la injuntes y i avatars, spostei da CollectionFS te n’autra memorisazion.
pause-all-migrations: Mëter tla pausa dutes la migrazions
s3-access-key-description: Tlé de azes AWS S3 per l’autentificazion
s3-access-key-placeholder: Inserì la clé de acess S3
s3-bucket-description: Inom dl bucket S3 per salvé i file
s3-enabled-description: Adurvé AWS S3 o MinIO per la memorisazion di file
s3-endpoint-description: URL dl endpoint S3 (per ej., s3.amazonaws.com o minio.example.com)
s3-port-description: Numer de porta dl endpoint S3
s3-secret-key-description: Tlé secreta AWS S3 per l’autentificazion
s3-secret-key-required: La tlé secreta S3 ie de bujën
s3-settings-save-failed: Ne n’ie nia stat meso salvé la mpustazions S3
s3-ssl-enabled-description: Adurvé SSL/TLS per la cunescions S3
schedule-board-backup: Planifiché la copia de segurëza dla tofl
writable-path-description: Streda dl ordinadëur de basa per la memorisazion di file
card-show-lists-on-minicard: Mustré la listes sun la minciarta
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Fej cuntroi y arjignamënc ntieres per la nteriëza di dac dla tofl, nce l orden dla listes, i posc dla ciartes y la strutura dla swimlanes.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Scancela zënza prisul la listes uetes dopies. Tol demez mé la listes che ne à deguna ciarta Y che à n’autra lista cun l medem titul cun ciartes.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Abina y ristabilësc ciartes y listes zënza swimlaneId o listId. Crieia na swimlane 'Lost Cards' per fé udëi inò duc i elemënc perdui.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Ristabilësc dutes la swimlanes, listes y ciartes tl archif. Arjigna da së nstës uni swimlaneId o listId che mancia, per fé udëi i elemënc.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Ciaria ora y arjigna listes che mancia o ie ruvinedes tla strutura dla tofl.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Atualisea i URL di avatars di mëmbri dla tofl per adurvé l backend de memorisazion jüst y arjigna i rimandi ai avatars ruvinei.
fix-all-file-urls-migration: Arjigné duc i URL di file
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Atualisea duc i URL dla injuntes sun chësta tofl per adurvé l backend de memorisazion jüst y arjigna i rimandi ai file ruvinei.
migration-successful: La migrazion ie fenida cun suzes
migration-failed: La migrazion ne n’ie nia jita
migrations-admin-only: Mé i aministradëures dla tofl possa fé jì migrazions
migrations-description: Fé jì cuntroi y arjignamënc dla nteriëza di dac per chësta tofl. Uni migrazion possa vester fata da sëula.
no-issues-found: Ne n’ie nia stat abinà problemes
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Chësc fej na migrazion dutëla per cuntrulé y arjigné la nteriëza di dac dla tofl. L possa durë n mumënt. Jì inant?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Chësc muda dant la listes spartides te listes per uni swimlane, pona scancela la listes uetes che à na lista dopia cun l medem titul cun ciartes. Mé la listes uetes dassënn de massa vën tëutes demez. Jì inant?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Chësc crieia na swimlane 'Lost Cards' y ristabilësc dutes la ciartes y listes zënza swimlaneId o listId. Chësc toca mé i elemënc che ne n’ie nia tl archif. Jì inant?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Chësc ristabilësc DUTES la swimlanes, listes y ciartes tl archif, y les fej udëi inò. I elemënc zënza ID vën arjignei da së nstës. Chësc ne se possa nia saurì desdì. Jì inant?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Chësc ciaria ora y arjigna listes che mancia o ie ruvinedes tla strutura dla tofl. Jì inant?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Chësc atualisea i URL di avatars di mëmbri dla tofl per adurvé l backend de memorisazion jüst. Jì inant?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Chësc atualisea duc i URL dla injuntes sun chësta tofl per adurvé l backend de memorisazion jüst. Jì inant?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Deguna swimlane, lista o ciarta perduda da ristabilì
migration-progress-note: Per plajëi aspeta ntant che migron tua tofl ala strutura plu nueva...
step-ensure-per-swimlane-lists: Fé che l sie listes per uni swimlane
step-ensure-lost-cards-swimlane: Fé che l sie la swimlane dla ciartes perdudes
step-scan-users: Se cuntrolea i avatars di mëmbri dla tofl
step-scan-files: Se cuntrolea la injuntes dla tofl
step-fix-file-urls: Se arjigna i URL di file
conversion-info-text: Chësta conversion vën fata mé n iede per tofl y fej jì miec. Te pos jì inant a adurvé la tofl normel.
converting-board-description: Se converti la strutura dla tofl per funzions miëures. L possa durë n mumënt.
hide-list-on-minicard: Platé la lista sun la minciarta
migrate-all-to-filesystem: Migré dut al sistem di files
migration-batch-size-description: Numer de injuntes da lauré te uni grop (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Mëter tla pausa la migrazion canche l’adurvanza dla CPU va sëura chësc percënt (10-90)
migration-delay-ms-description: Retert danter i grops te milisecundes (100-10000)
migration-info-text: La migrazions dla banca dac vën fates mé n iede y fej jì miec l sistem. L lëur va inant da zeruch nce sce te stlujes l browser.
migration-resume-failed: Ne n’ie nia stat meso jì inant cun la migrazion
migration-warning-text: Per plajëi ne stlù nia l browser ntant la migrazion. L lëur va inant da zeruch, ma l possa durë de plu.
monitoring-export-failed: No ie stat meso esporté i dac de monitorag
monitoring-refresh-failed: No ie stat meso ajorné i dac de monitorag
show-list-on-minicard: Mustré la lista sun la minciarta
showChecklistAtMinicard: Mustré la lista de control sun la minciarta
already-account: Es bele n cont? Jì ite
sign-in-to-upload: Jì ite per ciarié su repository
account-locked: L cont ie blocà per n pez per massa tentatifs de azes falei. Per plajëi prova inò plu tert.
otp-required: L code OTP ie de bujën
invalid-credentials: Inom utënt o parola secreta nia valic
username-password-required: L inom utënt y la parola secreta ie de bujën
password-mismatch: La paroles secretes ne va nia bën adum
username-too-short: L inom dl utent mëss avëi almanco 3 caraters
account-created: L cont ie stat crià! Sën pos jì ite.
account-creation-failed: Ne n’ie nia stat meso crië l cont
problems-summary-help: Marchea i ciamps cun problemes che te es cialà, pona cliché sun Tò a cunescënza per mëter a zero si numer de problemes nueves.
problems-in-progress-help: Chëstes migrazions o arjignamënc va sën. L jì ite possa vester lënt, o mustré "Must be logged in" o n indicadëur "Loading, please wait", nchin che les ie fenides y la CPU va ju.
problems-none-in-progress: Ne va deguna migrazion o arjignamënt.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: Arjignà __fixed__ ciarta(es). __unfixable__ ciarta(es) ne à deguna tofl y ne possa nia vester arjignedes da së nstësses.
restore-list-swimlanes-done: Ristabilì __restored__ lista(es). __remaining__ ne n’à nia pudù vester ristabilides.
export-card-details: Detaies dla ciarta (uni ciarta coche tl esport dla ciarta)
import-here-instruction: Importé ciò n esport de WeKan (.json o .zip):
import-scoped-failed: L import ne n’ie nia jit
import-not-wekan-export: Chël file ne n’ie nia n esport de WeKan
import-board-source: Importé na tofl (Trello, Jira, esport de WeKan, CSV, Excel, …)
import-report-description: La tofl ie unida creeda, ma n valgunes pertes dl file ne à nia pudù unì importedes. L medemo raport vën salvà te Panel d'aministrazion → Problemi → Ripristino.
import-parts-instruction: Mé la pertes marchedes vën importedes. La medema cernuda vën adurveda tl esporté.
import-wekan-file: Importé da n file de esport .json o .zip:
import-file-label: Choose the export file, or paste its text below:
sum-of-number-fields: Suma di i ciamps numerics personalisá mustrá insom la lista
date-range-of-fields: Spazi de dates di ciamps persunalisei de data marcà per mustré dessura tla lista
twoFactorAuth-enabled: L'autenticazion a doi fatours é atliada per tia cont.
twoFactorAuth-explanation: Aprovìsca n livel de segurëza dala pluma a tia cont. Sce atliada, tulessa ciafé n codesc da n'app de autenticazion uni iede che tu t'annunzies.
twoFactorAuth-scan-instructions: Scana chësc codesc QR cun n'app de autenticazion (p.ej. Google Authenticator, Authy), mo maten pona la ciafra de 6 cifres che la mostra per confermé.
twoFactorAuth-manual-entry: O maten chësc codesc a man:
twoFactorCode-prompt: Maten la ciafra de autenticazion de 6 cifres
twoFactorCode-invalid: Ciafra de autenticazion nia valida. Emprova endò.
wip-limit-group-add: Ajonté n grop de limit WIP
subtask-inherit-parent-labels: Tò sëura la etichetes dla ciarta paronda
subtask-done-no-permission: You cannot change whether this subtask is done
chart-forecast-none-remaining: Nia plu da fé - vigni ciarta é fata.

flow-note-agingWip: Ciartes daurides: dis dal’intreda tla fasa atuala. La bares cueceni va sëura l 85° percentil de dant (almanco cinch steies). La storia de intreda che mancia ne n’ie nia cunesciuda.
flow-note-blockerAnalysis: La storia dla dependënzes dà i tëmps de scumenciamënt/fin di blocs per uni fasa. I cunliamënc plu vedli possa avëi scumenciamënc nia cunesciui. La ciartes scancelades à de bujën de istantanees dla storia tenides. Rejons che se suraponn vën cuntedes da sëules.
flow-note-monteCarlo: 2.000 proves tol dis de calënder UTC ntieres, nce dis zënza rendimënt. La dates ie previjions dla coda auta; i numeri ie emprometudes dla coda bassa. Se mpensa a n rendimënt avisa tl daunì; nia na garanzia. Orizont plu aut: 3.650 dis. Zënza fenimënc nia previjion.
flow-note-processBehavior: L tëmp de ciclus adurvea l Scumenciamënt, o la creazion sce l mancia, y la Fin, o l archiviamënt sce la mancia. XmR mustra i valëures singui y la desferënzes un do l auter, cun la media y i limic naturei dl prozes; l ie de bujën de almanco doi fenimënc valic.
flow-note-sizeCycleTime: La stima atuala de Planning Poker o n ciamp persunalisà numerich tl confront cun l tëmp de ciclus fenì te dis. Stimes che mancia y dates nia valides vën lascedes ora. L Scumenciamënt tol la creazion sce l mancia; la Fin tol l archiviamënt sce la mancia.

scrum-import-into-board-hint: Choose a WeKan board export or Scrum transfer file. Sprints and releases this board already has are linked, never duplicated. Cards are matched by ID, or by card number and title; cards that do not match are listed and left unchanged. Preview first to see what will change.
scrum-import-invalid-file: This file is not valid JSON.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprints: __created__ new, __matched__ already on this board, __skipped__ not imported
scrum-import-preview-releases: Releases: __created__ new, __matched__ already on this board, __skipped__ not imported
scrum-import-preview-cards: Cards: __updated__ to update, __unchanged__ unchanged, __unmatched__ not matched
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Nothing to change: this board already has this planning.
scrum-import-into-board-done: The Scrum planning was imported and recorded in History.
scrum-import-card-not-matched: A card was not found on this board: __reference__
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: A card matches more than one card on this board: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: A card belongs to another board and was left unchanged: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: A sprint or release matches more than one on this board: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: A sprint, release or event could not be imported: __reference__
scrum-import-sprint-finished: A card was not moved into a finished sprint: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Chirì fora n valor per uni conflit. La sincronisazion prova danüef do uni lita. Al ne vën nia mané al sistem de urigin.
sync-conflict-refresh: Fejé jì la sincronisazion danüef per controlé i valorei atuai.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Les ciartes assegnedes a vos é unides controledes. Al ne resta degun conflit de ciamp. La sincronisazion de duta la lista ne é nia unida fata.
sync-conflict-detach: Mantenì l dopl coche ciarta locala
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Tolé via demé l colegamënt de sincronisazion de chësc dopl. Si contegn resta te WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive-hint: L elemënt de urigin ne é nia plu, ma les sotciartes atives impedësc l archiviazion. Mantenì chësta ciarta localmënter cun tolé via si colegamënt de sincronisazion. Les sotciartes ne vën nia mudedes.
sync-conflict-creation: Creé na ciarta de sostituzion per la sincronisazion
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Mantenì la ciarta de dan zënza mudéla y creé na nueva ciarta de sincronisazion te chësta lista. I nuefs tentatifs daura la medema sostituzion.
sync-preview-saved: Basé sules impostazions salvedes. Sincronisé sëura ciaria y controlea danüef la fontana.
sync-preview-unavailable: Salvé na fontana de sincronisazion dan de damandé na anteprima.
sync-preview-blocked: Solvé i conflits ca sot dan de controlé l plan dles mudaziuns.
sync-preview-truncated: Al vën mostré les primes 100 vosc.
sync-preview-scope: I numers se referësc ai ciamps normalisés dla fontana. L analisadëur dla fontana pò lascé ora d'autri dac.
sync-preview-excluded: Lascé ora dala lita di ciamps salveda
sync-source-heading: Ciamps dla fontana nia copies diretamënter
sync-source-scope: I percors met adum les ocorënzes di ciamps danter i elemënc dla fontana. I ogec zënza colegamënt vën segnalés coche n intier; si valorei ne vën nia mostrés.
sync-source-excluded: Lascé ora dala lita di ciamps salveda
sync-source-converted: Convertì te test o n'autra forma
sync-source-fallback: Valor alternatif nia dauré dal analisadëur
sync-source-occurrences: Ocorënzes mustredes de ciamps o elemënc
sync-source-truncated: La relazion é limiteda a 100 percors y inuemes di ciamps scurtés.
sync-source-omitted: Autres ocorënzes fora di percors mostrés
sync-report-retention: Ultimes 20 esecuzions. Les relazions vën conservedes per 30 dis.
sync-report-partial: Les esecuzions falides o nia fenides pò avëi mudé valguna ciarta. Chëstes relazions ne continua nia y ne anulea nia na esecuzion.
sync-report-unfinished: Tl laour o interot; resultat nia registré
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Fenì cun ciamps lascés ora o convertis
sync-report-unavailable: Les relazions dles esecuzions damanda l aces de scritura a duta la lista y n server a desposizion.
sync-recovery-description: Relazions de sincronisazion conservedes di ultimi 30 dis. Chirì aldò dl ID dla tabela o dla lista. Na esecuzion nia fenida pò ester mo tl laour o interota. Agiorné per controlé danüef; chëstes relazions ne pò nia continué o anulé les mudaziuns.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Al ne é nia stat meso lieje la diagnostica de sincronisazion. Controlé l aces de aministradëur y la disponibilità dl server.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Chirì fora n ciamp numerich cun n ID de ciamp Jira y na unità de stima, coche creé da na importazion Jira cun colegamënc. Les mudaziuns locales vën controledes coche conflits. I valorei dla fontana che manca vën ignorés; n null esplizit destuda l valor colegà.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab: Ciamp de stima sun chësc tofl
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Le pëis o la stima dl tëmp de GitLab vëgn scrita tl ciamp numerich che te chirjes. Les mudaziuns locales vëgn controlades desco conflits; n problem zënza pëis scancëla le valur colegá.
email-recovery-heading: Lista di messajes email da mandé
email-recovery-description: Na linia per vigni destinatèr. Chir cun l ID dl utent. L cuntenut di messajes y i ciampi cun la adresses email di destinatères ne vën nia mustrei. La pausa tegn ferm i messajes che ie bele y chëi che vën; reprënder proa da mandé sëura sen i messajes tla lista. Anulé scancëla i messajes metui tla lista nchin al mumënt dla dumanda. Sce l invié ie ocupà, proa inò do n curt tëmp. N messaje che vën bele mandà ne possa nia unì clamà zoruch, y n invié cun n resultat nia segur possa unì repetì. I fal permanënc y i messajes che à arjont l limit di tentatives resta a desposizion per la revijion. Proé inò i messajes nia mandai cun suzes taca n nuef cichl de tentatives y mantegn la pausa che ie bele.
email-recovery-attempts: Numer plu aut de tentatives repetii
email-recovery-pending: Tl aspeté o tl proé inò
email-recovery-empty: Degun messaje tla lista y degun destinatèr cun l invié en pausa.
email-recovery-unavailable: N ne possa nia liejer la lista di emails. Verifichëia l azes dl aministradour y la desponibilità dl server.
email-recovery-busy: N invié o n'autra operazion dla lista ie tlaur. Agiorna y proa inò do n curt tëmp.
email-recovery-failed: N ne à nia pudù cunfermé l'operazion. Agiorna la lista y proa inò la medema azion sce l ie de bujën.
email-recovery-superseded: N'azion plu nueva dl operadour à remplazà chësta dumanda. L vën mustrà l stat atuel dla lista.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Anulé duc i messajes che ie sen tla lista per chësc destinatèr? L cuntenut vën scancelà y ne possa nia unì recuperà. I messajes nueves creei do chësta dumanda vën mantignui.
email-recovery-retry: Proé inò i messajes nia mandai cun suzes
email-failure-smtp-temporary: Refudé da SMTP per n temp
email-failure-smtp-authentication: L autentificazion dla posta mëss unì controleda
email-failure-smtp-configuration: La configurazion dla posta mëss unì controleda
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Destinatèr nia a desposizion o cunt desativé
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: L invié ne é nia stat meso cunfermé; controlé dan de proé danüef
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: La ricevuda dl invié ne é nia unida salveda
email-failure-delivery-failed: L invié o la preparazion é falì
sync-time-estimate-hint: Les stimes dl temp daura i ciamps numerics dl temp original y dl temp che manca, creés dala importazion Jira. Te chësta tabela mëss ester apont n ciamp che corespon. Les mudaziuns locales vën controledes coche conflits; i valorei dla fontana che manca vën ignorés y n null esplizit destuda l valor.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint and releases are synced only while Scrum is enabled on this board. A sprint or release that is missing is created on this board, with the dates the source gives; an existing one is matched by its source ID first, then by name. A local planning change stays until the source changes that issue's planning, and a first Sync never removes planning.
activity-recovery-description: L invié dles notificazions nia fenides vën prové danüef automaticamënter. Controlé les ativités che manca o che é mudedes dan de proé danüef. Proé danüef ne creëia mai danüef na atività.
activity-recovery-empty: Deguna notificazion de atività che speta.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Al ne é nia stat meso ciarié les notificazions de atività che speta.
activity-recovery-status-preparing: A speté n plan di destinatères
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: L plan y l atività che speta ne corespon nia
activity-recovery-busy: N auter prozes laoura sun chësta notificazion. Agiorné y proé danüef.
activity-recovery-denied: L aces dl destinatèr o les preferënzes dles notificazions ne permet nia plu l invié.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: L atività originala manca o é mudeda. Al ne é nia unì creé danüef.
activity-recovery-disabled: Les notificazions de atività é desativées.
activity-recovery-failed: Al ne é nia stat meso fenì l invié dla notificazion. L laour che speta é unì mantenì.
activity-recovery-paused: L invié dles notificazions de atività é en pausa.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Chësta notificazion é mudeda da canche la é unida ciarieda. Controlé l stat agiorné dan de proé danüef.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Al ne é nia stat meso cunfermé l impostazion dl invié. Agiorné y controlé si stat atual.
activity-recovery-status-cancelled: L invié dles notificazions de atività é anulé.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Anulé definitivamënter l invié che manca per chësta atività? Al ne se pò nia continué do. Les e-mail bele tla coa y les notificazions bele manedes ne vën nia retirédes.
rule-email-recovery-description: Controlé i tentatifs registrés de invié e-mail dles regoles. I tentatifs nia cunfermés pò ester mo tl invié o interoc. Chësta relazion ne prova nia danüef y ne anulea nia l invié.
rule-email-recovery-identifiers: ID dl comand / dla invocazion / dl tentatif
rule-email-recovery-empty: Degun tentatif de e-mail dles regoles corespon a chësta chirida.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Al ne é nia stat meso ciarié i tentatifs de e-mail dles regoles. Agiorné per proé danüef.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ne manda mai inò da se nstës na e-mail nia cunfermeda. L'invié inò va mé ai destinatars nia cunfermei. Marché coche invià sce sabeis che la ie ruvada, o anulé l'invié.
rule-email-recovery-wait: L'invié uriginel possa ëssa mo en curs. Podeis dezider do __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Invié inò ai destinatars nia cunfermei
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Invié inò chësta e-mail ai destinatars nia cunfermei? Chi che si server de posta la à aceteda zënza avisè WeKan la ciafarà doi iedesc.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Marché chësta e-mail coche invià a duc? Fé chësc mé sce sabeis che la ie ruvada.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Anulé l'invié de chësta e-mail? La ne vegnirà nia invieda ai destinatars nia cunfermei.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: L'invié uriginel possa ëssa mo en curs. Pruevé inò plu tert.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: Chësta e-mail ie bele gnuda resulveda.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: N invié repetù de dant possa ëssa mo en curs. Pruevé inò plu tert.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Duc i destinatars ie bele cunfermei. Marché coche invià empë de inviè inò.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: L server de posta ne à nia respundù. La e-mail invieda inò possa ëssa ruvada o nia; la vën mustreda coche en curs.
rule-email-resolution-busy: N auter aministradëur ie dré a resolvé chësta e-mail. Pruevé inò danter puech.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: La e-mail salveda ne curespuend nia plu a chësc tentatif, donca ne possa la nia unì resulveda tlo.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: La registrazion salveda de chësc tentatif ne ie nia valida, donca ne possa l nia unì resulvù tlo.
rule-email-resolution-failed: L ne ie nia stat puscibl resolvé chësta e-mail. Ciarié inò y prué inò.
rule-email-legacy-heading: E-mails de regules che aspeta n cuntrol
rule-email-legacy-description: Chësta e-mails de regules ie gnudes preparedes da na verscion plu vedla de WeKan che ne à nia registré da ulache si cuntenut univa, donca ne les mandarà WeKan nia da se nstës. Cuntrolé danora sce l autëur dla regula à mo l dërt d'azès, y leghé la e-mail inò per la preparé inò da la ciarta coche la ie al mumënt, o scartéla.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Detais dla ciarta da na verscion plu vedla
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Preparé inò chësta e-mail da la ciarta coche la ie al mumënt? Si cuntenut possa ëssa auter che chël preparé dant.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Scarté chësta e-mail? La ne vegnirà mai invieda.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Deguna e-mail de regules aspeta n cuntrol.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: L ne ie nia stat puscibl ciarié les e-mails de regules che aspeta n cuntrol. Ciarié la plata inò per prué inò.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: L autëur dla regula ne à nia plu azès a chësta ciarta, o la regula ie mudeda, donca ne possa la e-mail nia unì ligada inò. Podeis la scarté.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: L'ativité che à destedé chësta e-mail ie mudeda, donca ne possa la nia unì ligada inò. Podeis la scarté.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: La ciarta da ulache chësta e-mail univa ne ie nia plu a desposizion, donca ne possa la nia unì ligada inò. Podeis la scarté.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: L'esecuzion dla regula che à preparé chësta e-mail ne ie nia plu salveda, donca ne possa la nia unì ligada inò. Podeis la scarté.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Chësta e-mail ie bele gnuda invieda, pruveda a inviè o scarteda.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Chësta e-mail ie bele gnuda ligada inò.
rule-email-legacy-failed: L ne ie nia stat puscibl fenì chësta azion. Ciarié inò y prué inò.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: The list was removed, recreated or its Sync settings changed
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: The user who started it no longer has write access to the whole list
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Saved by an earlier WeKan version without what started it
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: The record of who started it is missing
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: It can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Discard this saved List Sync operation? Changes it already applied stay; the rest are never written. The list can then Sync again.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: No List Sync operations are waiting for review.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Discard some and refresh to see more.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Could not load the List Sync operations. Refresh to try again.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: This operation is no longer pending.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: This operation has not been found stuck, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: This operation can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it was not discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: This list is syncing right now. Try again in a moment.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: L ne ie nia stat puscibl fenì chësta azion. Ciarié inò y prué inò.
interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ swimlanes, __lists__ lists, __cards__ cards, __checklists__ checklists, __comments__ comments, __attachments__ attachments
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Discard this import? The board it created and everything on it are removed permanently.
interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.
interrupted-import-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Keep or discard some and refresh to see more.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.
interrupted-import-missing: This import is no longer recorded.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: This import is not waiting for a decision any more.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: The board with this id was not created by this import, so it was not touched.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Its Scrum stage is still being written or recovered. Try again in a few minutes.
interrupted-import-failed: L ne ie nia stat puscibl fenì chësta azion. Ciarié inò y prué inò.
saml-login-not-started: Chësta registraziun SAML ne é nia unida metuda a jì te chësta scheda dl browser. Registrëive danüef.
history-request-pending-undo: Vosta ultima anulaziun ne é mo nia unida cunfermeda dal server.
history-request-pending-redo: Vosta ultima repetiziun ne é mo nia unida cunfermeda dal server.
history-request-hint: Proé danüef repët la medema domanda, y per chël ne pò nia anulé na segunda mudaziun.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: An undo, redo or restore of Scrum changes stopped on a conflict. Scrum edits on this board are blocked until it is resolved.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ of __total__ changes were written, __pending__ were not, and __conflicted__ were changed by someone else since.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Rolling back puts every changed record back as it was before; it is offered only when nobody else has changed those records since. Keeping the board as it is removes the stopped operation and changes no records. Either way, it is recorded in Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Keep the board as it is
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Keep every record as it is now, including the changes the stopped operation already wrote?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: A board administrator can roll it back or keep the board as it is.
login-setting-clear-secret: Scancelé le valur salvé tl panel d’aministrazion
login-setting-after-restart: À efet do avëi inviè indô WeKan
login-setting-env-only: Only the server environment sets these. They are shown here read-only.
email-to-card-description: N e-mail mandà al’adressa de tua tofl devënta na ciarta sun chëla tofl.
email-to-card-webhook: URL dl webhook en entrada dl fornidëur de posta (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark o n relé MIME crù)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Salvé - lascé vet per l tenì
email-to-card-clear-secret: Gaué l secret dl webhook salvé
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Tofl olache va la posta mandeda a chësc grain
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Deguna - mé e-mails cun n token dla tofl tl argumënt
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Met chësc tl argumënt per arjonjer chësta tofl coche te nstës:
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Lascé demez i messaghes de denant citei
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Rie dl mandant sun l prinzipie dla descrizion
email-to-card-your-address: Tua adressa e-mail per chësta tofl
email-to-card-address-private: Tienl privat: chiche l à possa junté ciartes sciche te.
email-to-card-new-address: Indirizz nuef (chël vedl ne va nia plu)
email-to-card-member-enabled: I mi indirizc dla tofles va
email-to-card-off-admin-off: L giaurì e-mails ne n’ie nia mpustà tl Panel de aministrazion.
email-to-card-off-board-off: N aministradëur dla tofl ne n'à nia ativà la posta per chësta tofl.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Te es desativà tua adresses dla tofles tla Mpustazions dl mëmber.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: L grain ne à mo nia si adressa e-mail. Ciaria inò la plata.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Te ës debojegn dl acess de scritura a chësta tofl.
inbound-domain-invalid: Chësc ne n'é nia n inom de domine valid.
inbound-domain-required: Dà l domine di indirizc dla tofles.
inbound-account-invalid: Na ciassela IMAP à debojegn de n inom de server valid.
feature-views-email-desc: La tofl coche cassela de posta: la lista de e-mails ie la Posta che rua, la listes ie ordinadëures, la etichetes ie etichetes, y i mëmbri scrij y respuend ai e-mails dal’adressa dla tofl.
email-view-not-receiving: Chësta tofl ne giaura mo nia e-mails. Ativea chësc tla Mpustazions dla notificazions dla tofl → E-mail te ciarta.
email-view-invalid-address: Una dla adresses ne n’ie nia n’adressa e-mail valida.
email-view-too-many: Massa e-mail mandades tl'ultima ora. Proa danü plu tert.
email-view-no-list: La tofl à debojegn de na lista por la posta.
email-view-send-failed: L e-mail ne n’à nia pudù vester mandà.
feature-views-chat-desc: La tofl sciche spazi de ciacolada: spazi de laur, tofli, stredes, listes y ciartes sciche n ber de canai, la ciarta tl mez y si coments sciche messajes de ciacolada.
chat-view-pick-card: Cerni na ciarta dai canai por la odëi chiló.
chat-view-no-messages: Ćiamò nia de messajes. Scrí le pröm.
feature-views-version-control-desc: La tofla sciöche n tracker de problems GitHub o Gitea: ciartes sciöche problems, etichetes y tapes, comënc sciöche conversaziun, injuntes sciöche files y la storia dla tofla cun desfé.
vcs-no-issues: Degügn problem ne corespogn a chësta cërcia.
vcs-no-milestones: Ciamò degöna tapa. N'etiheta cun scadënza é na tapa.
vcs-issue-title-required: N problem à debojëgn de n titul.
vcs-no-list: Chësta tofla n'à degöna lista o corsia por le problem.
card-qr-code-desc: Scanerëde por daurí chësta ciarta sön n telefonin o tablet.
card-qr-code-too-long: Le link de chësta ciarta é massa lunch por n code QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Ćiamò degun wiki. La importaziun de n’organisaziun GitHub porta ca le wiki de n archif de codesc.
github-org-import-desc: Vigni archif de codesc de n’organisaziun o de n utënt deventa süa tofla, daurida te Board View / Version Control: si problems cun comënc, etichetes y files, sües publicaziuns, si workflows GitHub Actions sciöche regules, y so wiki.
github-org-import-token-hint: Ad ö por archifs de codesc privac y n limit API plü alt. Al vëgn adoré ma intratan la importaziun y nia mai salvé.
github-org-import-issues: Problems, cun comënc, etichetes y files
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Scrí le inom de n’organisaziun o de n utënt, o so indirizz GitHub.
github-org-import-no-repos: Degun archif de codesc da importé.
github-org-import-running: Na importaziun de n’organisaziun é bele en cors.
optional-apis-desc: API REST te la forma dles API d'atri tracker, ajache sües aplicaziuns y scripts pois adoré chësc WeKan sciöche backend: ci che ai salva vëgn tigní te WeKan, sön tofles de WeKan. Vignöna é destodada cina ch'ara vëgn marcada chilò. Degöna n'à dërc da süa pert: n client se lëia ite cun n token API de WeKan y po odëi y mudé ma ci che chëra porsona po odëi y mudé te WeKan. Dötes adoress che la API REST de WeKan sides ativada (WITH_API=true). L'indirizz sot a vignöna é ci che n client adora sciöche so server.
optional-api-trello-desc: Aplicaziuns y scripts scrić por la API REST de Trello (por ejëmpl Trellinator) funziona cun WeKan: tofles, listes, ciartes, etichetes, mëmbri, comënc y listes de control. Le token de Trello é n token API de WeKan. Scancelé na ciarta la sposta tl archif de WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: I clients dla API REST v2 de Jira funziona cun WeKan: n proiet é na tofla (süa tlé é la tlé dla tofla), n problem é na ciarta (DEV-7), n stato é na lista, y na transiziun sposta la ciarta. La crida azeta JQL scemple: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text y ORDER BY. Lëiede ite cun n token API de WeKan sciöche parola secreta. Scancelé n problem le sposta tl archif.
optional-api-github-desc: I clients dla API REST de GitHub por problems funziona cun WeKan: n archif de codesc é na tofla, n problem é na ciarta, cun etichetes, tapes (etichetes cun data de scadënza), comënc, y daurí o stlüt sciöche te Vijion dla tofl / Control dles verscions. Le token é n token API de WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: I clients dla API REST de Gitea y Forgejo por problems funziona cun WeKan, tl medem codesc dla API compatibla cun GitHub: n archif de codesc é na tofla y n problem é na ciarta. Le token é n token API de WeKan.
vcs-synced-from: Sincronisé da %s: daurí y stlü le ilò.
vcs-synced-issue: Chësc problem é sincronisé: daurí y stlü le te so sistem.
email-bounces-description: Cie che WeKan fej cun i e-mails che torna zeruch: n’adressa scrita mel, na cassela plëina, na resposta de assënza, n reclam de spam. Uni sort à si azions, fates canche l ie turnà zeruch tan de iedes.
email-bounces-enabled: Gestí les mail tornades zeruch te WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Ne mandé plu mail a chesta adressa
email-bounces-action-notify-inviter: Dì a chi che l'à invedà
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: L'adressa ne esist nia: n fal de scritura, n cont scancelé, n domine nia cognosciù.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Nia consegnada per śen: caseta piena, server ocupé. Demè tantes te fila vuel dì zeche.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Respostes de assenza, de vacanza o de n sistem de ticket. La mail é stata consegnada.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: L destinatar à segnà la mail coche spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Te Amazon SES, mandé les notifiches Bounce y Complaint, y na regola de receziun per l'adressa da olache WeKan manda, a n tema SNS, y abonede chesta adressa a chel tres HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN di temes SNS da azeté, un per riga
email-bounces-stopped-only: Demè les adresses a chëres che WeKan ne manda plu mail
email-bounces-clear-hint: Desmentié i retorns de chesta adressa y i mandé indò mail
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Chest ne n'é nia n ARN de tema SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: Sce WeKan spediësc tres un de chisc servizs, l'ativëia, da al servize chësta adressa webhook por si events de mail tornades zeruch y reclams de spam, y taca ite chilò la tle cun chëra che al les firma, o la parola de acess che t'as metù te l'adressa sciöche https://user:password@… o ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: N servize ativé à de besëgn de si tle de firma o de si parola de acess.
